notes.title: INCOMING UPDATE: PSYCHODEATH狂死
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello SPIRITS IN THE SCREEN [霊],[/h1]
After meditating upon a mountaintop for many moons, my eyes shot open, and I reached a grand realization: this game has so much more potential, so much more to give.
And not only that, but you, the players and fans, the ones who bother to read this and/or give feedback, deserve to have your voices heard, and not just heard, but acted upon. 
[h1]I am working on an update, one of many, that will make the game a more full, pleasant experience.[/h1]
[h2][list]
[*] In this coming update, there will be more levels, available to all, that will make the gameplay much longer. 
[*] In this coming update, there will be new mechanics, that will allow for more ways to fight and win.
[*] In this coming update, there will be many under-the-hood optimizations that will make gameplay smoother on more devices.
[/list][/h2]
[h1]Stay tuned,
STS[/h1]
